featured_reviews.name: Avinash Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had at this pet store, and honestly I’m still upset thinking about it. From the moment I walked in, the place felt poorly maintained and depressing. The floors were dirty, there was a strong smell in the air, and the overall environment looked like it hadn’t been properly cleaned or cared for in a long time.

What really broke my heart, though, was seeing the kittens. There were about 15 kittens that looked barely two months old crammed into a single tiny cage. The cage was far too small for that many animals. They were all climbing over each other, scratching at the bars, and trying desperately to get out. Several of them looked extremely stressed and scared. Instead of playful, curious kittens like you’d expect, they just looked sad and uncomfortable. Watching them push against the cage door and meow was honestly heartbreaking.

It didn’t seem like they had enough space, stimulation, or proper care. The bedding looked dirty, and the whole setup felt more like storage than a place for living animals. Seeing such young kittens packed together like that made the entire experience feel really upsetting.

To make matters worse, everything in the store was wildly overpriced. Basic supplies that you can find elsewhere for reasonable prices were marked up way beyond what they should cost. When a store is already poorly maintained and clearly not prioritizing animal welfare, charging inflated prices just makes the whole thing feel even more frustrating.

The staff also didn’t seem particularly attentive or concerned about the animals. When I asked a question about the kittens, the response felt dismissive and rushed, as if my concerns weren’t important.

Between the overcrowded cages, the sad-looking kittens, the poor maintenance, and the ridiculous prices, this place left a really bad impression. A pet store should be a place where animals are treated with care and respect, not crammed into tiny cages and left in uncomfortable conditions.

I genuinely hope the store improves how it cares for its animals, because what I saw was really disappointing and upsetting. Until then, I would strongly recommend people look elsewhere for their pets and supplies.
Animals are living organisms with emotions not objects that you can treat however you want.I request you all to have a look and raise this issue,as a cat lover,this genuinely broke my heart.

Also I've been to the store many times and you never asked me my name so you can't say that when you reply.this is not a fake review.

featured_reviews.name: Urvashi Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had recently rescued two 2-month-old kittens and consulted a veterinarian, who prescribed Bolfo/Notix powder for flea treatment. Unfortunately, the product was unavailable at Arya pet store, and the staff recommended an alternative, assuring us that it was a “medicated” flea treatment suitable for the kittens.

What they failed to disclose—or possibly did not realize—was that the product was toxic to young kittens, resulting in severe toxic shock shortly after application. The kittens began exhibiting serious symptoms, including foaming at the mouth and extreme drowsiness, which prompted an emergency visit to the veterinarian. It was a distressing experience for us and the couple who supported the rescue.

Thankfully, the kittens received prompt veterinary care and are now in recovery. We are closely monitoring their condition and remain hopeful that they will make a full recovery without long-term neurological effects.

This incident has been a difficult and eye-opening experience, emphasizing the importance of using only vet-prescribed products, especially with young or vulnerable animals. We sincerely hope no other rescued or domestic animals face a similar situation due to misinformation or inappropriate product recommendations

featured_reviews.name: Dinesh Pushpan
featured_reviews.review_text:
5/5 Stars

I recently boarded my kitten, Toffee, here for 5 days while I traveled to Goa. This was his first time away from home, and I was quite anxious about how he would cope, especially since he’s not used to other cats like my dog, Kandy.

I couldn’t have asked for a better experience! The place was spotlessly clean, and Toffee had his own complete room, which made me feel so much better. Gayatri, the owner, herself has a couple of dogs and a cat, so she is very sensitive to the needs of my cute fur baby. She sent regular photos and videos, so I could see he was happy and well cared for. When I picked him up, he was right back to his usual routine, which tells me he had a great time.

I highly recommend this home boarding to anyone looking for a safe, caring, and comfortable place for their pets. Thank you, Gayatri, for taking such good care of Toffee—I’ll definitely be back!

featured_reviews.name: Saumya Vohra
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently boarded our 7-month-old Shih Tzu puppy, Sugar, at BFF Pet Store, and we’re very thankful for the care he received. This was his first time away from us for almost 15 days, so we were quite anxious, especially since he hadn’t stayed with other dogs before.

What really stood out was that they board many toy breeds and young pups, making the environment feel safe and suitable. The place was clean, well maintained, and not at all commercial, with both open play areas and comfortable indoor spaces.

Gayatri, the owner, was another big reason we chose this boarding. She is incredibly kind and clearly understands pets, having dogs and cats of her own. She regularly shared photos and videos, kept us updated on Sugar’s meals, and even provided homemade food while accommodating special dietary requests.

Thank you so much for taking such wonderful care of Sugar. I would definitely recommend this boarding place to anyone looking for a safe, caring, and thoughtful environment for their pet.

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Khanduri
featured_reviews.review_text: I just wanted to share my absolute delight with BFF Pet Spa! My 11-year-old furry friend has always been a bit of a challenge during bath time, but this amazing team makes it a breeze. Gayatri and her staff are so gentle, caring, and professional - it's clear they truly love what they do. My dog might not show it yet! But I think he's secretly like’s it. If you're struggling with pet grooming, I highly recommend giving BFF Pet Spa a try - you (and your pup!) won't regret it!

featured_reviews.name: Humaira K.
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience with BFF,I got my cat groomed with them and the whole process was a calming and stress free.Gayatri had a wonderful staff that handled my baby with love and care,She came back clean,lighter and amazingly smelling😄.Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Lalchandani
featured_reviews.review_text: We got grooming and trimming done for my pet Golden retriever and these guys did a great job. Gayatri was very supportive and polite, and took good care of my dog! Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Crazy India
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently boarded our two fur babies, Chai and Coffee, at Gayatri's Pet Spa & Boarding for 10 days, and we couldn't be happier with the experience!

From the moment we connected with Gayatri, we felt a sense of comfort. She is incredibly kind-hearted and genuinely caring towards animals—something that comes naturally to her as an animal rescuer. It was so reassuring to know our babies were in such loving hands.

Chai and Coffee were pampered with delicious home-cooked meals served right on time, had a cozy and clean sleeping area, and plenty of playtime in the spacious open area with other friendly dogs. It truly felt like a second home for them!

We also had a wonderful grooming session at the spa—our pups looked clean, happy, and well taken care of.

Highly recommend Gayatri's Pet Spa & Boarding to anyone looking for a safe, warm, and joyful place for their pets. Thank you, Gayatri, for treating my babies Chai and Coffee like your own!
